title: Customer-added comments and positioning feedback
summary: This topic is dominated by brief customer-added notes, with the clear opinionated examples split between liking the car’s appearance or overall vehicle quality and isolated mentions of problems or unmet preferences.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention enjoying the car, praising its appearance, and describing it as a very good vehicle.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention an issue affecting IPA and a recurring problem the customer had also experienced on a prior BMW.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are mostly short customer-added notes about prior ownership, dealership consultation, range, preferences, or not yet trying a feature, and the examples are too fragmentary to support a clearer thematic reading.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined and many are short administrative-style fragments, which limits confidence in identifying a single coherent customer issue.
Some sampled fragments appear weakly related or potentially contradictory in sentiment labeling, so the topic may mix general customer-added notes with a smaller set of actual opinions.
